# Security Policy

If you discover a security vulnerability in MicrOSAL, report it privately so
it can be addressed before public disclosure.

Use the repository's GitHub Security tab to open a private vulnerability
report. Do not include vulnerability details or exploit code in a public issue.

Please include:

- Affected versions, backends, and components
- Detailed steps to reproduce the issue
- The relevant OS, RTOS, compiler, and build configuration
- Any proof-of-concept or test code that demonstrates the impact

Maintainers will investigate the report and coordinate disclosure after a fix
is available.
